g.text: Requirement: built by allowlist at the node, validated by strict schema at the hub (not signed)
(never the article row: name, internal id,
Keep template attributes with shareable = true
Free text only as synonym code
or short text (<= 60 chars), else unknown
GTIN only if check digit valid
Why not signed (D34): the client already
receives all article data from the node, and
the hub schema enforces minimization. A node
signature could be added later around the same
